title: peer_fetch: fragile string match on http-body-util internal error message
description: peer_fetch.rs:461,571: size-exceeded detection uses msg.contains("length limit") matching against an internal error string from http-body-util. If a future crate version changes the error message text, SizeExceeded errors will be misclassified as generic Network errors — downstream hash-mismatch failures instead of clean early rejection. No compile-time signal. Wrap Limited collection in a typed result enum or use a custom body collector that avoids string-matching.
